name: Billing - Invoice creation, approval, and payment
description: Verifies the full invoice lifecycle: creation from approved SES, approval workflow, payment recording, and status tracking

planSteps.description: Assert that invoices list shows with status columns (draft, issued, approved, paid, cancelled)
Click 'New Invoice' and select an approved SES to base the invoice on
Assert that invoice is pre-populated with SES line items, quantities, and totals
Configure invoice settings: currency, tax percentage, payment terms
Assert that invoice status changes to 'issued' with unique invoice number
Approve the invoice and then navigate to /dashboard/payments/new to record payment
Enter payment amount, reference number, date, and submit
Assert that invoice status updates to 'paid' and payment reference is visible
